# affected-tests

> Select the Python test files affected by changed files using a static ast import graph, with conservative run-all triggers. Python package `trysac-affected-tests`, import name `affected_tests`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its decisions
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run the tests and what they cover
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model with defended and undefended risks

## Optional
